summary: First test run on Alhasani Pondok Pesantren app. Backend: 27/27 pytest tests pass (serial) — admin+santri login, santri CRUD + duplicate NIS, tagihan compute, pay/duplicate reject, bebaskan+revert, payment GET + santri isolation (403/404), jadwal CRUD, absensi save+read, dashboard (both periode), kamar/ustadz/pengurus/ustadz CRUD, role-based access (pengurus→403 on /keuangan,/users; ustadz→403 on /santri; both OK on allowed resources), keuangan CRUD with totals, change-password flow. Frontend: admin and santri logins work, wrong password shows toast 'NIS/Email atau password salah', dashboard renders stats + Top 5 cards + periode toggle, all pages (Santri, Pembayaran, Keuangan, Jadwal, Master, Pengguna, Portal) load with required data-testid attributes. Kwitansi /kwitansi/28 renders Envelope C5 landscape container (865×612 px, ratio 1.414 = 229/162), correct header 'PONDOK PESANTREN ALHASANI LIMPUNG · Jl. KH. Wahid Hasyim No. 01 Limpung', amount Rp 100.000, terbilang 'Seratus ribu rupiah', signature = pengurus name ('yano'). Santri portal shows Tagihan/Jadwal/Kehadiran tabs with own data.
critical_code_review_comments: pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope but session-scoped fixture test_santri in test_alhasani.py was not safe across workers — fixture now tolerates 400 'NIS sudah terdaftar' so parallel re-runs don't flake. Prefer -o addopts='' or `-n 0` for deterministic serial runs.

auth.py:88 bug in login_attempts tracking: on failed login it writes attempts=0 when `locked` is set, so the fifth failure records attempts=0 (locked_until correct). Harmless but counter is misleading. Minor.
server.py adds CORSMiddleware AFTER include_router so OPTIONS preflight on routers works via Starlette ordering; still functions, but conventionally add_middleware before include_router.
No pagination on /api/santri, /api/users, /api/keuangan — fine for current scale (~10 santri) but will not scale to full pondok population.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ santri (TEST{epoch}), TEST pengurus & ustadz user accounts, TEST_ jadwal, TEST_K_ kamar, TEST_U_ ustadz, TEST_kategori keuangan row, 1 syariah payment — all deleted in pytest teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses isolated Supabase schema alhasani_test (DB_SCHEMA env). Pytest config pins -n 2 --dist loadscope; the TEST_NIS collision across session fixtures is now tolerated. To run serially use: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_alhasani.py -o addopts='' -v`. Kwitansi URL pattern: /kwitansi/{id_pembayaran}. For Pembayaran UI flow, click [data-testid=pembayaran-santri-{nis}] to open billing grid, then [data-testid=billing-pay-btn-YYYY-M] / [data-testid=billing-override-status-btn-YYYY-M].
